motion_notes.spin: Complete actors turn clockwise E-SE-S-SW-W-NW-N-NE-E. The edge must turn the same way, with45-degree successive keys; view rotation applies only to engaged poses. Recovery unwinds174→135→90→70 rather than reversing180 degrees into guard.
motion_notes.slam: Continuous load100→35→60, then115→175→225 contact, replacing the180-degree entry flip. Windup exposure redistributes within the unchanged0.32-second clock.
motion_notes.preservation: No complete body pixels, palette, grip positions, running/idle, white effect/audio or combat data modified by this correction.
motion_notes.chop: Bound the initial windback to40-degree steps; recover240→155→70 instead of200→70 wrist snap.
